mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at Badger Prairie County Park. Tonight, look up to the sky around 5:43 PM to catch the International Space Station, which will be visible from Mount Horeb all the way toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, soaring high overhead.

The City of Verona has released notices regarding the upcoming fall and spring elections, while the Plan Commission is preparing to review development projects, including the Sub-Zero site plan, at their December 7th meeting.

There is plenty to do this week, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's, followed by the John Denver tribute concert at the High School Fine Arts Center on November 15th.
On October 23rd, police made contact with two juveniles on eMotos, which resulted in their parents being cited for allowing them to drive prohibited vehicles on the road.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
